اضطغنت (form VIII)
# اِضْطَغَنْتُ (iḍṭaḡantu) /idˤ.tˤa.ɣan.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# اِضْطَغَنْتَ (iḍṭaḡanta) /idˤ.tˤa.ɣan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# اِضْطَغَنْتِ (iḍṭaḡanti) /idˤ.tˤa.ɣan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# اِضْطَغَنَتْ (iḍṭaḡanat) /idˤ.tˤa.ɣa.nat/: thi
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
